title: CTD: Cascaded Temporal Difference Learning for the Mean-Standard Deviation Shortest Path Problem
venue: IEEE transactions on intelligent transportation systems (Print)
abstract: This paper investigates the reliable shortest path (RSP) planning problem from the reinforcement learning perspective. title: Using Reinforcement Learning to Minimize the Probability of Delay Occurrence in Transportation
abstract: Reducing traffic delay is of crucial importance for the development of sustainable transportation systems, which is a challenging task in the studies of stochastic shortest path (SSP) problem. Existing methods based on the probability tail model to solve the SSP problem, seek for the path that minimizes the probability of delay occurrence, which is equal to maximizing the probability of reaching the destination before a deadline (i.e., arriving on time).
